entries.4484529fdebd7f53: This business processes parts for large bearings. It receives raw materials supplied by bearing manufacturers and performs turning of the outer and inner rings of large bearings used in industrial machinery and railway vehicles, turning of rollers, and grinding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥415 million.
entries.6c04c065ca56c7b2: Implement bodies such as forage harvesters
entries.8e6f948c7216a413: Implement bodies, including dairy and livestock forage harvesters (feed-production implements) used to harvest grass, feed rice, and feed corn, and their attachments. Revenue by product category is not separately disclosed.
entries.b95c070ca81f3a9f: Sales of replacement parts for implements. Sales results classify these as parts, but the segment notes do not disclose their revenue separately.
entries.bbc2113b785affe3: Soil-improvement implements, such as compost spreaders used to apply organic fertilizer, and implements used to spread fertilizer and soil conditioners. Revenue by product category is not separately disclosed.
entries.cabd3e37a849f1bd: A company that manufactures and sells agricultural work machines used for harvesting pasture grass and forage crops, and also performs parts processing for large bearings.
entries.e90f63a311096c27: Agricultural machinery manufacturers and sales companies
entries.f673fefba850230c: This business manufactures and sells agricultural implements. Its products include forage harvesters for the dairy and livestock industries, which are used to harvest grass, feed rice, and feed corn, as well as soil-improvement implements, which are used to spread fertilizer and soil conditioners, and snow-removal equipment. Shandong Wuzheng Gaobei Agricultural Machinery Co., Ltd., a Chinese joint venture, is responsible for production and sales in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,132 million.
